module: Flowgraph node "End Screen" (category once_instant, singleActive): displays the end screen of a scenario with customizable buttons (UI navigation 'scenario.end'). Inputs: "title", "text" (string or table), "progress", "timeStr" (text or seconds -> MM:SS.ss), "successString", "failString", "failed", "medal", "autoPoints", "points", "maxPoints", "portraitSuccess", "portraitFail", "stats" (endStats), "change", "attempt", "progressKey". Each button option (editable list, default "cont") creates a string input pin (label) and a flow output pin set to true on click. Buttons added automatically: Retry (data.includeRetryButton), Scenarios (data.includeScenarioButton) and "Start Next Mission" for each following mission of the activity.
notes: Showing two of these at the same time will break everything (todo from the code).

Bug: with autoPoints, 'points + v.points or 0' and 'max + v.maxPoints or 0' have wrong operator precedence (the 'or' applies to the sum), so a statistic without points causes an addition error with nil.
If failed is true, the medal is forced to 'wood'.
The missionData block (progress, leaderboard, stars) is built only if an activity is in progress and the "change" pin is connected.
A commented-out block at the end of openDialogue references an undefined variable 'change'.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets all output pins to false and open = false.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's state from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Writes the node's state to the save table.

buttonPushed.desc: Called by the UI when a button is clicked; sets the output pin named after the button to true (the others to false) and closes the dialogue.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

closeDialogue.desc: If the screen is open, navigates to the UI state 'play' and open = false.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Button list editing (rename, delete if text is empty, add, rem).

getCmd.desc: Returns the Lua command that finds this node and calls buttonPushed(action).

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

init.desc: Initializes options, oldOptions, open = false and data.includeRetryButton = true.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: closes the screen at the end of the level.

onNodeReset.desc: Closes the screen and resets the outputs to false.

onResetGameplay.desc: Hook: closes the screen if the Retry button is active.

openDialogue.desc: Assembles buttons, text, time, medal, points, stats, portraits and mission data, then navigates to 'scenario.end'.

postInit.desc: Creates the "cont" (Continue) option, the corresponding pins and the templates of the medal pin.

updateButtons.desc: Recreates the button pins according to options, restoring the existing links.
